items.name: Bonus Leveling
items.overview: A group of handpicked celebrities become “players” and are transported against their will to a mysterious world where they must compete in a series of games. items.name: Prue and Sandi's South African Adventure
items.original_name: Prue and Sandi's South African Adventure
items.overview: Long term pals Prue Leith & Sandi Toksvig are finally embarking on the trip of a lifetime together. Prue’s South African roots have defined her life and career. Now, she’s taking Sandi on and off the beaten track to discover the best the country has to offer. They travel from Cape Town, where Prue was born, to Johannesburg, where she grew up. Packed full of fascinating facts and personal anecdotes, each episode explores the history, nature, politics, culture and food of the places they visit. There’s hands-on activity, from wine sabrage to fishing, as they’re guided by fascinating locals, artisans and experts. Whether it’s by boat, balloon, quad bike, or safari vehicle, Prue and Sandi experience a journey they’ll never forget, and inspire others to do the same.

items.name: 你为谁诉讼
items.overview: After her father is framed and dies, lawyer Su Qing takes on a powerful businessman through a series of civil lawsuits, uncovering the truth while confronting the limits of her pursuit of justice.

items.name: The Great Food Con
items.overview: Craig Reucassel reveals how ultra-processed foods are now linked to a range of harmful health effects and asks - do we really know what we're eating anymore?

items.name: Blade Runner 2099
items.overview: Fifty years after the events of Blade Runner 2049, Los Angeles has been reborn, just not by humanity. Cora, a fugitive in a final bid to stop running, takes on one last identity: a Blade Runner. Forced to partner with Olwen, a Replicant days from dying, she hunts down a runaway hiding a truth that could collapse their fragile city.

items.name: Andrew Tate: Toxic Empire
items.overview: Andrew Tate: Toxic Empire is a four-part documentary miniseries from Investigation Discovery (ID) examining the rise of Andrew and Tristan Tate and the allegations surrounding their business ventures and online influence.

items.name: I Want To Kill My Boss
items.original_name: I Want To Kill My Boss
items.overview: Exploring murder cases from across the country, in which simmering resentments and personal vendettas in the workplace escalate to a lethal place.

items.name: 天地男儿
items.overview: After discovering a diary that connects him to a desperate man twenty years in the past, a bankrupt man devises a plan with his newfound companion to change both their fates.

items.name: Un vrai boulot : des soignants pas comme les autres
items.original_name: Un vrai boulot : des soignants pas comme les autres
items.overview: Laurent Ournac, Virginie Hocq, Delphine de Saxe-Cobourg, Jill Vandermeulen, and Henri PFR have agreed to step into the shoes of a nurse. To kick off this adventure, the five celebrities begin their journey at the CHC MontLégia clinic, where they undergo practical training and learn which department they have been assigned to. The news sparks excitement in some, while for others, it causes stress levels to soar. Following an early wake-up call, they begin their very first shift. They are introduced to the mentors who will guide them throughout their placement and then meet their patients—a deep dive into the reality of the profession, with a long day only just getting underway.

items.name: Missie Verhulst
items.overview: Gert and Viktor Verhulst have a new mission: to mercilessly prank well-known Flemish and Dutch celebrities. With hidden cameras, meticulously crafted plans, and help from unexpected quarters, the father-son duo pulls out all the stops to lure their friends into a trap.

items.name: Jeugdpsychiaters
items.overview:
Gilles De Coster engages in conversation with seven child and adolescent psychiatrists. They share personal accounts of the challenges they face and what it is like to practice their profession.

*Jeugdpsychiaters* (Child and Adolescent Psychiatrists) is a four-part interview series exploring both the individuals and their craft—much like previous VRT Canvas series such as *Strafpleiters* (Criminal Defense Lawyers), *Misdaaddokters* (Forensic Doctors), and *Sekswerkers* (Sex Workers).

items.name: Shinji: Double Shuffle
items.overview: Reborn with memories of a forbidden love, a man pursues his former lover again, only to find him cold, distant, and changed.

items.name: Nine to Six
items.overview: Falsely blamed for a car fire, Chronic Motors Senior Manager Kang Yi-ji faces demotion. Can she find love and happiness amid office politics?

items.name: Dateline Canada
items.overview: The Canadian franchise will be helmed by veteran journalist and Dateline Canada contributing correspondent Diana Swain, who had a 33-year career with CBC prior to launching her own corporate communications firm in 2024. The longtime investigative journalist is a former Executive Producer of flagship CBC investigate program, The Fifth Estate, and left CBC as Managing Editor, Investigative Journalism.

items.name: ราวัณกัลยา
items.original_name: ราวัณกัลยา
items.overview: Two performers challenge prejudice and traditional expectations as they pursue their place in the world of Thai khon dance.

items.name: Always on Call
items.overview: A devoted team of medical professionals navigate personal struggles, political pressure and a risky new hire at an overwhelmed emergency room in Oslo.

items.name: Fool Night
items.overview: In a dark world full of despair, he chooses the path of transforming into a Spirit Flower — a plant into which humans transform. Should he continue living as a person, or discard his pain and start a new life as a plant? Which path would you choose in his situation?

items.name: Reading Bones Identifying Hearts
items.overview: After being transported from the modern world to the chaotic state of Xin, forensic examiner Yan Qing uses her advanced expertise to solve mysterious murder cases and expose conspiracies. As she investigates a series of shocking murder cases, she forms an uneasy alliance with the cold and powerful Shi Ting.

items.name: Stalin
items.overview: The series covers key periods of Joseph Stalin's rule, from the end of World War II to his death in 1953.

items.name: A Filipino Christmas
items.overview: Discover the true meaning of the season in this touching anthology featuring estranged friends, a snowy Christmas, office rivals, and clashing sisters.

items.name: Death Ward
items.overview: The drama is based on a famous real-life case that took place in Alexandria in the late 1990s. A nurse named Aida Nour El-Din was accused of deliberately murdering one patient and attempting to kill more than 30 others by injecting them with a dangerous substance at the hospital where she worked. She was also accused of stealing medication.

items.name: Toos: The Van der Valk Kidnapping
items.original_name: Toos: De van der valk ontvoering
items.overview: 1982. When the matriarch of a Dutch hotel empire is kidnapped for ransom, her family launches a desperate effort to free her.

items.name: The Story Untold
items.overview: A traumatized artifact restorer opens her heart to an undercover cop battling drug traffickers, whose ultimate sacrifice helps her overcome past wounds and embrace life courageously.

items.name: Sathyameva
items.overview: Haunted by an innocent client he couldn't save, Advocate Rajaram, a washed-up defence lawyer, takes up the dying plea of a man everyone called mad, to find a daughter missing for twenty years, and drags into the light a woman the powerful made sure would never be found.Filing the dead man's plea as a Habeas Corpus petition, the lawyer traces a twenty-year-old disappearance through an orphanage and a buried police file to a woman the powerful would rather stayed lost, and finds one last shot at the justice, and the redemption, that both of them were denied.

items.name: Dhai Chaal
items.overview: An ambitious politician navigates the treacherous corridors of power, bending rules and forging alliances in a ruthless climb to the top. Morality blurs as survival demands compromise in this dark exploration of political machinations.

items.name: Ritus
items.overview: On the Night of the Moon’s Turning, the body of a teenage girl who has been missing for 18 years surfaces in a lake – intact, as if time had preserved her. The clues lead to an ancient ritual that has been carried out for millennia deep beneath the surface of a mountain. An eternal cycle that operates in secret - and exacts its price.

items.name: Alan Carr's Great Big Bucket List
items.original_name: Alan Carr's Great Big Bucket List
items.overview: This series sees Alan and some of his comic friends embark on an international mission to road-test classic 'bucket list' experiences, determining which of them are truly 'try before you die' — and which should never be spoken of again…

items.name: Just Human Friends
items.overview: Three pairs of celebrity friends embark on a special trip to celebrate their combined 85 years of friendship. As they travel together, they share candid conversations, playful banter, and memorable moments that reveal the natural chemistry and genuine bonds behind their long-standing friendships.

items.name: 风生水起
items.overview: Three years after his fiancée is presumed dead in a revenge attack, a police officer returns to investigate a series of interconnected crimes.

items.name: The Art of Deception
items.overview: The series tells the extraordinary story of Joanna Segelström, a key figure in one of the biggest art market scandals. The influential art dealer is accused of orchestrating one of Europe’s most extensive art-related Ponzi schemes and causing massive financial losses for hundreds of people.

items.name: Wintertime
items.overview:
Nine years after their last encounter, Koo Seung Hyeok and Kwon I Hyeon unexpectedly reunite at Nexus, a nightclub linked to organized crime. Seung Hyeok, now the club manager, confronts I Hyeon, who works in lowly conditions, leading to a series of hostile interactions rooted in past grievances. When I Hyeon’s father is diagnosed with cancer, he reluctantly re-engages with Seung Hyeok under a work and debt agreement. This forced collaboration ignites complex emotions, as hatred and fixation intertwine. As both men grapple with their tumultuous history—Seung Hyeok's contempt and I Hyeon's struggle with vulnerability—they face the choice between continued conflict or an unforeseen future together.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Winter Season" (동절기) by Iromil (이로밀).

items.name: Salish's 12 Games of Christmas
items.overview: Salish Matter and seven of her closest friends compete in 12 epic holiday challenges for a mountain of Christmas presents, hosted by her dad, Jordan. But there's a twist: a Christmas imposter is hiding among them, out to sabotage the games and swipe the gifts. Can they unwrap the culprit before it’s too late?

items.name: AndherPura Curse
items.overview: AndherPura Curse Is A Minecraft Series Presented By SmilyBag.

items.name: 笑探太平镇
items.overview: A demoted detective is stuck leading four eccentric female officers in a small town, where their chaotic partnership gradually develops into an unlikely crime-solving team.

items.name: My Boss I Love You
items.overview:
My name is Chama, the owner of an import-export company so successful that I was given several businesswoman awards. As my business grew, the need for more employees grew as well, which led me to meet Nilmookda.

She was a newly graduated student who had applied for the accounting department. The moment I saw her, I knew it was love at first sight. She was the one for me.

I began giving her bouquets, leaving Post-its on her desk, and showering her with fruits and gifts. But her reaction was not what I expected. She became paranoid, convinced someone was watching her. Oh, even though my intentions were good, her response made me lose all confidence!

items.name: The Grim Lover
items.original_name: รัก ลืม ตาย
items.overview: Framed for murder following his partner's untimely death, a man finds an unlikely ally in the Grim Reaper, who looks eerily familiar to the man he lost.

items.name: Story Starts from Bed
items.overview: After a chance encounter during a wild night, two people entrenched in hookup culture fall into an unexpected romance. As they try to make their impulsive connection last, temptation and emotional baggage threaten to pull them apart.

items.name: Oleg’s Play Lab
items.overview: Welcome to Olegs Play Lab. Part tech zone, part wild story circle, the Lab is where cool gadgets meet pure imagination. Join Oleg to unbox toys, play epic games, and think outside the box.

items.name: O Humorista
items.overview: The mockumentary *O Humorista* was born out of a partnership between Jel and João Cunha, who secretly portrayed a character during his live performances for over two years without anyone knowing.

items.name: In the Dark – Wer übersteht die Nacht?
items.original_name: In the Dark – Wer übersteht die Nacht?

items.name: The Boy Who Stole Billions?
items.overview: At 30, Sam Bankman-Fried ran a $32 billion crypto empire until he was convicted of stealing $8 billion in customer funds, one of the biggest frauds in U.S. history. For the first time, he tells his story from prison.

items.name: The World as It Is
items.overview: The World as It Is" is a documentary series hosted by Dan W. M'massa that explores the many issues facing today's world.

items.name: Beechwood Falls
items.overview:
Beechwood Falls presents a high-stakes dramatic arc centered on ambition, moral choices, and the cascading consequences of impulsive actions.

Set against the backdrop of Atlanta, the series follows Jeriko Davenport, a charismatic college football player

items.name: İlk Göktürk
items.overview: The story follows Bumin, a humble blacksmith, who leads a historic uprising following a betrayal by the Avar King. This rebellion marks the pivotal moment when the Turks emerged on the world stage to establish their first state under the name 'Turk'.

items.name: The Poppy and Viva Show
items.overview: Poppy and Viva are having a tv show!

items.name: Den ofrivillige tomten
items.overview: When the lawyer Per is chosen to become the new Santa Claus, a hectic double life begins: he must juggle his job and family life in the ordinary world while simultaneously training for his new role at the magical North Pole. Will he manage to get through the entire month of December as an accidental Santa?

items.name: Crossing borders
items.overview: Oscar leaves his struggles in Bosnia to study medicine in Lund, Sweden. Alongside eccentric roommate Erik and letting agent Nora, he navigates culture shock and romance with childhood friend Selma.

items.name: Collect & Praise
items.overview: Faith comes second to fortune as a money-hungry pastor and his unpredictable deacon scheme their way through scandal, chaos and controversy.

items.name: Dil Ki Bewafaiyaan
items.overview: Married to his best friend Janaki, Manav longs for the grand love story they never lived. Now in his forties, can he give their bond a romantic makeover?

items.name: Dry Summer
items.overview: In the 1970s, in the village of Çarlak in Adana, Osman and his older brother Hasan work the land to make ends meet, but Osman’s deep love for Bahar upsets the balance between the two brothers.

items.name: Calder
items.overview: When Mira Calder meets her dying brother, she must decrypt codes to find out the mystery of her father and uncover what is lying in the ocean...

items.name: Knight Rider: Declassified
items.overview: A 5-part, 5-hour documentary premiere event featuring new, never-before-seen interviews with the cast, creators, and crew who brought the iconic series to life. From the creation of KITT to the untold realities behind the scenes and the legacy that followed, this is the most comprehensive look ever produced at one of television’s most enduring legends.

items.name: Bonne nuit Chuck
items.overview: After completing rehab, Chuck—a disgraced TV presenter—discovers he has a son who is also an addict and spiraling toward self-destruction. Chuck scours the underbelly of Quebec City to find him, putting his own sobriety at risk in the process.

results.name: The Story Untold
results.overview: A traumatized artifact restorer opens her heart to an undercover cop battling drug traffickers, whose ultimate sacrifice helps her overcome past wounds and embrace life courageously.

results.name: Sathyameva
results.overview: Haunted by an innocent client he couldn't save, Advocate Rajaram, a washed-up defence lawyer, takes up the dying plea of a man everyone called mad, to find a daughter missing for twenty years, and drags into the light a woman the powerful made sure would never be found.Filing the dead man's plea as a Habeas Corpus petition, the lawyer traces a twenty-year-old disappearance through an orphanage and a buried police file to a woman the powerful would rather stayed lost, and finds one last shot at the justice, and the redemption, that both of them were denied.

results.name: Dhai Chaal
results.overview: An ambitious politician navigates the treacherous corridors of power, bending rules and forging alliances in a ruthless climb to the top. Morality blurs as survival demands compromise in this dark exploration of political machinations.

results.name: Ritus
results.overview: On the Night of the Moon’s Turning, the body of a teenage girl who has been missing for 18 years surfaces in a lake – intact, as if time had preserved her. The clues lead to an ancient ritual that has been carried out for millennia deep beneath the surface of a mountain. An eternal cycle that operates in secret - and exacts its price.

results.name: Alan Carr's Great Big Bucket List
results.original_name: Alan Carr's Great Big Bucket List
results.overview: This series sees Alan and some of his comic friends embark on an international mission to road-test classic 'bucket list' experiences, determining which of them are truly 'try before you die' — and which should never be spoken of again…

results.name: Just Human Friends
results.overview: Three pairs of celebrity friends embark on a special trip to celebrate their combined 85 years of friendship. As they travel together, they share candid conversations, playful banter, and memorable moments that reveal the natural chemistry and genuine bonds behind their long-standing friendships.

results.name: 风生水起
results.overview: Three years after his fiancée is presumed dead in a revenge attack, a police officer returns to investigate a series of interconnected crimes.

results.name: The Art of Deception
results.overview: The series tells the extraordinary story of Joanna Segelström, a key figure in one of the biggest art market scandals. The influential art dealer is accused of orchestrating one of Europe’s most extensive art-related Ponzi schemes and causing massive financial losses for hundreds of people.

results.name: Wintertime
results.overview:
Nine years after their last encounter, Koo Seung Hyeok and Kwon I Hyeon unexpectedly reunite at Nexus, a nightclub linked to organized crime. Seung Hyeok, now the club manager, confronts I Hyeon, who works in lowly conditions, leading to a series of hostile interactions rooted in past grievances. When I Hyeon’s father is diagnosed with cancer, he reluctantly re-engages with Seung Hyeok under a work and debt agreement. This forced collaboration ignites complex emotions, as hatred and fixation intertwine. As both men grapple with their tumultuous history—Seung Hyeok's contempt and I Hyeon's struggle with vulnerability—they face the choice between continued conflict or an unforeseen future together.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Winter Season" (동절기) by Iromil (이로밀).

results.name: Salish's 12 Games of Christmas
results.overview: Salish Matter and seven of her closest friends compete in 12 epic holiday challenges for a mountain of Christmas presents, hosted by her dad, Jordan. But there's a twist: a Christmas imposter is hiding among them, out to sabotage the games and swipe the gifts. Can they unwrap the culprit before it’s too late?

results.name: AndherPura Curse
results.overview: AndherPura Curse Is A Minecraft Series Presented By SmilyBag.

results.name: 笑探太平镇
results.overview: A demoted detective is stuck leading four eccentric female officers in a small town, where their chaotic partnership gradually develops into an unlikely crime-solving team.

results.name: My Boss I Love You
results.overview:
My name is Chama, the owner of an import-export company so successful that I was given several businesswoman awards. As my business grew, the need for more employees grew as well, which led me to meet Nilmookda.

She was a newly graduated student who had applied for the accounting department. The moment I saw her, I knew it was love at first sight. She was the one for me.

I began giving her bouquets, leaving Post-its on her desk, and showering her with fruits and gifts. But her reaction was not what I expected. She became paranoid, convinced someone was watching her. Oh, even though my intentions were good, her response made me lose all confidence!

results.name: The Grim Lover

results.overview: Framed for murder following his partner's untimely death, a man finds an unlikely ally in the Grim Reaper, who looks eerily familiar to the man he lost.

results.name: Story Starts from Bed
results.overview: After a chance encounter during a wild night, two people entrenched in hookup culture fall into an unexpected romance. As they try to make their impulsive connection last, temptation and emotional baggage threaten to pull them apart.

results.name: Oleg’s Play Lab
results.overview: Welcome to Olegs Play Lab. Part tech zone, part wild story circle, the Lab is where cool gadgets meet pure imagination. Join Oleg to unbox toys, play epic games, and think outside the box.

results.name: O Humorista
results.overview: The mockumentary *O Humorista* was born out of a partnership between Jel and João Cunha, who secretly portrayed a character during his live performances for over two years without anyone knowing.

results.overview: At 30, Sam Bankman-Fried ran a $32 billion crypto empire until he was convicted of stealing $8 billion in customer funds, one of the biggest frauds in U.S. history. For the first time, he tells his story from prison.

results.name: The World as It Is
results.overview: The World as It Is" is a documentary series hosted by Dan W. M'massa that explores the many issues facing today's world.

results.name: Beechwood Falls
results.overview:
Beechwood Falls presents a high-stakes dramatic arc centered on ambition, moral choices, and the cascading consequences of impulsive actions.

Set against the backdrop of Atlanta, the series follows Jeriko Davenport, a charismatic college football player

results.overview: The story follows Bumin, a humble blacksmith, who leads a historic uprising following a betrayal by the Avar King. This rebellion marks the pivotal moment when the Turks emerged on the world stage to establish their first state under the name 'Turk'.

results.overview: When the lawyer Per is chosen to become the new Santa Claus, a hectic double life begins: he must juggle his job and family life in the ordinary world while simultaneously training for his new role at the magical North Pole. Will he manage to get through the entire month of December as an accidental Santa?

results.overview: Oscar leaves his struggles in Bosnia to study medicine in Lund, Sweden. Alongside eccentric roommate Erik and letting agent Nora, he navigates culture shock and romance with childhood friend Selma.

results.overview: Married to his best friend Janaki, Manav longs for the grand love story they never lived. Now in his forties, can he give their bond a romantic makeover?

results.name: Dry Summer
results.overview: In the 1970s, in the village of Çarlak in Adana, Osman and his older brother Hasan work the land to make ends meet, but Osman’s deep love for Bahar upsets the balance between the two brothers.

results.name: Calder
results.overview: When Mira Calder meets her dying brother, she must decrypt codes to find out the mystery of her father and uncover what is lying in the ocean...

results.name: Knight Rider: Declassified
results.overview: A 5-part, 5-hour documentary premiere event featuring new, never-before-seen interviews with the cast, creators, and crew who brought the iconic series to life. From the creation of KITT to the untold realities behind the scenes and the legacy that followed, this is the most comprehensive look ever produced at one of television’s most enduring legends.

results.name: Bonne nuit Chuck
results.overview: After completing rehab, Chuck—a disgraced TV presenter—discovers he has a son who is also an addict and spiraling toward self-destruction. Chuck scours the underbelly of Quebec City to find him, putting his own sobriety at risk in the process.
